protected_authorship_observations.authorship_boundary: Current conversation model authored the original knowledge/comparison documents from local exported evidence; external research/model calls are recorded false; human semantic acceptance remains false.

positive_path_checks.summary: Requires accepted_for_real_trial=true, checks every manifest file digest and size before creating an exist_ok=False trial directory, and preserves failed partial state for inspection.
Uses the stopped source through PYTHONPATH, the pinned repository virtualenv Python, -B, offline/no-download flags, disabled pytest plugin autoload, and source cwd.
Adds exactly three fixed-hash PDFs with fixed page counts and requires fresh knowledge/comparison evidence, paper snapshots, and coverage to equal the protected model-reviewed contexts before import.
Checks three current records, builds views, imports the comparison, requires a five-line Markdown table and at least nine source-page links, and resolves local links for published pages.

Prepares a workflow session, creates/verifies/reuses/restores a backup, verifies every manifest row byte-for-byte against ZIP and restored content, checks session relocation/history, reindexes, checks current knowledge/views, preserves original paper files, and rejects PDF copies in the final inventory.

Checks the stopped owner manifest before and after the selected suite, records source-local module provenance, exact command/environment, JUnit counts, stdout/stderr hashes, and source snapshot identity.

bounded_harness_notes.summary: The trial guard accepts any path containing a '.work' component, rather than requiring strict containment under ROOT/.work. The parent invocation must supply the approved ROOT/.work trial path; the harness itself does not enforce that boundary.
The repeated backup create asserts reused=true but does not compare the archive SHA-256 before and after reuse. The resulting summary hashes the final archive only.

Returned readable/index/page paths are checked for existence and links, but are not explicitly asserted to remain inside the trial workspace; restored verification checks every manifest row but does not reject extra restored files.
Original paper preservation compares files captured after each add, but does not separately assert that no unexpected extra paper files were introduced. Final inventory still rejects PDF files.

The full suite selects the tests directory and therefore records no harness hash; selected independent/backup files are hashed only when they exist. Missing harness files are silently omitted from the evidence record.

The frozen recorder requires stopped_writing=true and file hashes, but does not independently require manifest schema, snapshot_sha256, or ready_for_final_acceptance fields. Those remain upstream manifest/parent checks.

review_limits: No active T3 runner, real trial, Cursor process, network, Git mutation, Vault mutation, or source implementation was executed or changed.
No human claim, provenance, scientific correctness, visual quality, or semantic acceptance is inferred from the engineering harness.
The final accepted-for-real-trial manifest was not present at this review checkpoint; its exact hash and source rows must be recorded when the parent freezes it.
